mechanism: Online-learned policy over context-assembly levers of the harness
evidence_scope: treat the harness as a small, fixed, human-legible action space and learn a policy over it online with classic sample-efficient reinforcement learning
evidence_role: A control system: an outer harness policy (contextual bandit and REINFORCE) over a six-lever context space (prompt style, tool/retrieval policy, memory policy, planning depth, verification policy, step budget), built on DSPy
